cell.copyPath: Copy the path that reads this
cell.prettyJson: Try to pretty-print the value as JSON

edit.hint: Double-click a cell to edit · click the # to mark a row for deletion
edit.logEvents: Log events cannot be edited: a cloud log service is read-only.
edit.mongoNote: These changes are applied one at a time, not as a single transaction. If one fails, the earlier changes will already be saved.
edit.nothingToSave: Nothing to save. Fill in a new row or change a cell first.

explain.noTable: This statement reads no table, so there is nothing to estimate.
explain.notAPlan: The server answered, but not with a plan this can read.
explain.notExplained: This server would not explain that statement.
explain.rowCountUnknown: The row count for this table is not loaded.

wouldRead.one: Would read about {rows} rows from 1 table, before running it.
wouldRead.other: Would read about {rows} rows from {count} tables, before running it.

footer.bytesTitle: Bytes the database read to answer this. On a columnar engine it is what a query costs, whatever the number of rows it returns.
footer.cutShortTitle: A cap stopped the read before the end of the range, so this is a prefix of the answer and not all of it. Narrow the range or add a filter.
footer.editingProdTitle: Editing is allowed on this production connection until the app restarts. Click to lock it again.
footer.eventsRead: {scanned} events were read to answer this.
footer.eventsReadMatched: {scanned} events were read to answer this, of which {matched} matched.
footer.limitMore: Auto-LIMIT {limit} was appended. Next past the last row fetches another {limit}. Change the size in Settings → Editor & Query.
footer.limitNote: Auto-LIMIT {limit} was appended. Change it in Settings → Editor & Query.
footer.rowsRead: {scanned} rows were read to answer this.
footer.rowsReadMatched: {scanned} rows were read to answer this, of which {matched} matched.
footer.trueTotalTitle: True total, ignoring the fetch limit

grid.columnDefault: Column default: leave blank to use "{value}"
grid.deleteHint: Click to mark this row for deletion
grid.lockedTitle: This is a production connection, so editing is locked. Choose "Allow editing" to unlock it for this session.
grid.openAsTree: Open this value as a tree

lines.closeAll: Every line is open. Click to close them all.

log.changeWrites: Changing this writes the range into the statement and runs it.
log.fromSqlTitle: This range came from the statement, so the control above does not apply to it. Remove the time bound from the WHERE to use it.
log.noRangeAdd: The statement named no time range, so that is what ran. Look further back, or add a bound of your own with `WHERE ts >= ago('24h')`.
log.noRangeEdits: The statement named no time range, so that is what ran. Looking further back writes the range into your SQL, as `WHERE ts >= ago('24h')`.

mode.log: Log reader (one line per event, expandable)
mode.record: Record view (one row at a time)

search.columnsTitle: Search all columns of the rows loaded in the grid
search.linesTitle: Search the lines loaded in the reader. Matches anywhere in an event, including inside a folded-away payload.

view.noWritePath: This backend has no write path: an ingested log event cannot be changed.
view.prodLocked: This is a production connection, so editing is locked. Click to allow editing for this session.
view.runKeys: runs the statement under the cursor, or the selection.
view.runPrompt: Run a query to see its results here.

wrap.full: Rows expanded to fit their whole value. Click for single-line rows.
wrap.lines: Wrapping over {lines} lines. Click to expand every row to fit its whole value.
wrap.off: Wrap long text over {lines} lines (click again to expand every row to fit)
wrap.tooMany: Too many rows on this page to expand each one, so they stay {lines} lines. Click for single-line rows.
